title: Stacksmith Tool Configuration Layer
description: Partial merge layer for Defines backend, provider mappings, module mappings, OpenTofu version, and validation rules for stacksmith.

source.description: Reference source type for local files.

path.description: Local filesystem path to the referenced file.

source.description: Reference source type for Git-hosted files.

repo.description: Git repository URL for the referenced file.

path.description: Path inside the Git repository to the referenced file.

ref.description: Git ref, branch, or tag used to resolve the reference.

source.description: Reference source type for HTTP(S) URLs.

url.description: HTTP or HTTPS URL for the referenced resource.

source.description: Reference source type for registry module references.

address.description: Registry module address in the format <namespace>/<name>.

source.description: Reference source type for Git-hosted modules.

repo.description: Git repository URL for the referenced module source.

ref.description: Git ref, branch, or tag used to resolve the module source.

path.description: Optional path within the Git repository to the module source.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the validation rule.

inline.description: Inline Python expression or code block. `value` is available in scope and a truthy result passes validation.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the validation rule.

script.description: Structured reference to a Python validation script.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the transform rule.

inline.description: Inline Python code defining `transform(value, **context)` and returning the transformed value.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the transform rule.

jinja.description: Jinja template rendered with the surface-specific `property.value` or `output.value` in scope. Rendered output is JSON-decoded when valid JSON, otherwise treated as a string.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the transform rule.

script.description: Structured reference to a Python transform script defining `transform(value, **context)`.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this component property.

mapped_to.description: Optional mapped module input name for the property. If omitted, the original property name is used.

default.description: Default value used when no explicit value is supplied for this module property.

transform.description: Optional transformation applied to the property value before it is passed to the module.

validation.description: Optional validation rule applied to the resolved property value.

auto_inject_inputs.description: Optional per-property override for module auto-injection. Set to false to skip injecting this input even when module auto_inject_inputs is enabled.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the public component output.

mapped_from.description: Underlying module output name. Defaults to the public component output name.

transform.description: Optional transformation applied to the unresolved module output reference before it is exposed to component consumers.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the fallback module mapping.

source.description: Template-capable fallback module source. String fields may reference `component.type` and `component.name`.

auto_inject_inputs.description: When true, resolved input values are auto-injected into modules using the default mapping.

auto_expose_outputs.description: When true, same-name outputs discovered from modules using the default mapping are exposed as component outputs. Explicit output mappings remain authoritative.

tags.description: Optional module-level tags applied to components using the default mapping.

providers.description: Optional provider mappings applied to components using the default mapping.

properties.description: Optional property configuration applied to components using the default mapping.

outputs.description: Public outputs exposed by components using the default mapping.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this operation input.

required.description: Whether callers must provide this input.

secret.description: Whether this input must be redacted from execution state and logs.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between Jenkins queue and build status checks.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the Jenkins build to finish.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the post-plan validation.

enabled.description: Whether this plan validation rule should be executed. Defaults to true.

rule.description: Python validation rule to apply to parsed OpenTofu JSON plan output.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this provider instance.

alias.description: Provider alias used for non-default instances.

providerConfigSpec.description: Provider configuration specification as inline code, script reference, or static data.

inline.description: Inline Python code defining `config(**context)` and returning a provider configuration mapping.

script.description: Structured reference to a Python provider config script defining `config(**context)`.

data.description: Provider-specific YAML mapping such as region, assume_role, endpoints, and retry settings.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this provider family.

instances.description: Named provider instances. A default instance is optional; non-default instances must be explicitly aliased.

url_template.description: Parameterized download URL template. Supports placeholders like {version}, {os}, and {arch}.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 checksum for the downloaded artifact.

sha256_url_template.description: Optional parameterized URL template pointing to a checksum file for the artifact.

version.description: Required tool version constraint or exact version.

download.description: Optional download metadata for resolving missing binaries.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this managed configuration.

type.description: Auth type: 'token' for Bearer token, 'basic' for username/password, 'ssh' for SSH key.

token_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Bearer token.

username_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the username for basic auth.

password_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the password for basic auth.

ssh_key_path.description: Path to the SSH private key file.

remote_auth.description: Optional per-host auth configuration for fetching remote resources. Keys are hostnames.

var_validations.description: Optional per-variable Python validation rules applied after all resolution layers. Keyed by variable name. `value` holds the resolved variable value.

plan_validations.description: Optional post-plan validation rules keyed by name. Rules run against parsed OpenTofu JSON plan output unless disabled.

backend.description: Backend configuration with explicit backend type and freeform backend-specific settings.

type.description: OpenTofu backend type (for example: s3, local, azurerm, gcs, oss).

tools.description: OpenTofu and Terragrunt version and download settings.

provider_mappings.description: Provider families keyed by OpenTofu provider name.

description.description: Optional friendly display name for the module. Used by stacksmith inspect output when present.

source.description: Structured module source reference. Use `source: git` with `data.repo`/`data.ref` and optional `data.path`, or `source: registry` with `data.address`/`data.version`.

auto_inject_inputs.description: When true, resolved input values are auto-injected into this module mapping by exact input key match and declared mapping keys. Defaults to false.

auto_expose_outputs.description: When true, same-name outputs discovered from the underlying module are exposed as component outputs. Explicit output mappings remain authoritative. Defaults to false.

tags.description: Optional module-level tags used for tag-expression targeting.

providers.description: Optional module provider mapping. Keys are module provider names, values are provider instance references in `<provider>.<instance>` format.

properties.description: Optional per-property configuration for module inputs. Keys are original property names from stack resources.

outputs.description: Public component outputs keyed by the names stack authors reference through Jinja.

module_mappings.description: Module mappings keyed by abstract resource type.

default_module_mapping.description: Fallback mapping used when no explicit mapping exists for a component type.

operations.description: Approved native operations keyed by operation name. Stack definitions can only select an entry from this catalogue.
